summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing its stock repurchase program, authorized to acquire up to $1 billion in aggregate of its Class A and Class B common stock. The filing provides daily disclosure to the ASX under local rules. No specific price, premium, or timeline is stated; the program is ongoing and at management's discretion. The board is not making a specific recommendation in this filing. No advisor is named. The buyback reduces the public float and provides a return of capital to shareholders. Watch for quarterly disclosures of repurchase activity and any program amendments or suspensions.
